game.name: The Little Girl Mill of a Gingko
game.desc: This is an action RPG in which you play as a young girl named Mill who has a fairly special kind of stork as a faithful companion. Mill sleeps quietly in her bed when she is awakened by events outside. Two birds died on the ground, and this attracted the crowd. And who's going to go get the reason for these mysterious events?

game.name: Princess Maker 2
game.desc: Like in Princess Maker 1, the story begins with a demon army attacking the kingdom, led by Lucifon the Prince of Darkness. Lucifon was sent by the Deities to punish the people of a medieval city for their sinful ways. A wandering Swordsman (You) sneaks into the camp one night and defeats Lucifon in hand-to-hand combat. He and his armies retreat. The grateful King invites you to stay and grants you an annual salary of 500 gold pieces. Then, one night, the Swordsman hears a voice and goes out to see a girl floating in an orb of light. He is then spoken to by the girl's patron deity who asks him to raise her. How he raises her will determine if mankind has truly repented.

game.name: Tanggle's Magic Square
game.desc: Tanggle's Magic Squares is a puzzle game with Bejeweled leanings. You rotate columns of little twirling fruits and vegetables (With eyes! And headbands!) until you get a whole row of one type. That row then disappears, and a few more fruits wander into your existing pile. You do this until all of the fruits disappear

game.name: Astonishia Story R
game.desc: Astonishia Story R is the GP32's first RPG, developed by Game Park's solitary first tier developer. The game is beautiful; *lots* of animation, detailed sprites, randomly flying birds, huge towns and an interesting cast of characters. This is PSOne quality 2D, without a doubt. It has a solid (though simple) battle system, which is like a merger of traditional and strategy RPGs.

game.name: Dooly Soccer 2002
game.desc: El tercer y último juego de Corea del Sur basado en la famosa serie de animación local "Pequeño Dinosaurio Dooley", dedicado a la Copa Mundial de 2002. El género es un futsal de arcade sin una historia completa. Hay dos modos: "historia" y "libre". El primero requiere jugar para el equipo formado por Dooley y sus amigos - los personajes de la serie animada tienen que vencer a una variedad de otros equipos y, en última instancia, obtener el derecho, como representantes de Corea, de jugar con el equipo de "todas las estrellas", formado por los mejores jugadores del mundo.

game.name: Dungeon & Guarder - Dragon Gore
game.desc: Un sencillo y sangriento beat 'em up con un tema medieval. Añade experiencia, objetos y magia a la mezcla, y comienza a sentirse como algo interesante. Quizás lo mejor del juego es que los desarrolladores (Gamepark) obviamente saben lo que se necesita para una exitosa paliza. El juego tiene una sensación muy temprana de Capcom, que se refuerza con los sprites gigantes y la música pseudo-europea.

game.name: Dyhard - With Infinite Stairs
game.desc: Dyhard - with infinite stairs is a platformer in which you walk back and forth against your will, only able to jump up on platforms, while trying not to fall down. In other levels you try to hop down onto platforms, trying not to get killed by the rocks above. The sprites are nice and large. It has good style, and gets bonus points for the very cool art and nice story.

game.name: Gp Fight
game.desc: El juego es un beat'em up en el que estás en una escuela y los estudiantes parecen estar en guerra unos con otros. Puedes elegir entre 6 estudiantes diferentes (2 chicas y 4 chicos), que tienen diferentes estadísticas que realmente no importan. En cada nivel el juego te hará hacer un objetivo determinado, como sobrevivir durante 120 segundos o matar a todos los demás o recoger comida mientras golpeas a tus compañeros. Después de cada etapa se clasificarán las 4 personas de la etapa (incluido el jugador). Si no llegas a estar entre los 3 primeros, el juego se termina (no hay continuaciones). Hay 3 personajes ocultos que deben ser desbloqueados, y el juego tiene 5 etapas. Sólo hay tres tipos de temas en este juego que pueden hacer que sea aburrido. Está el tema de la introducción, la música del juego y luego el juego sobre la música.

game.name: Hany Party Game
game.desc: Hany Party Game is a collection of assorted mini games all packed into one. It was released in two iterations: Star Ball and Tower Master.

game.name: Her Knights - All For The Princess
game.desc: Her Knights: All for the Princess is a spin-off of Geunyeo-ui Gisadan - Her Knights. Princess Lemian is forced to marry a man she does not love. As she tries to escape from the unwanted wedding, she realizes that her path is blocked by soldiers. Her faithful knights arrive to fight them and help the princess escape. Unlike the preceding game, All for the Princess is a 2D side-scrolling beat-em-up. The player can choose to control any of the five available knights. There are too basic attacks - fast and strong. Combo attacks can be performing by combining these two with directional buttons. There are separate controls assigned to blocking ans evasive manoeuvres. The knights can also strafe backwards, while turning around is performed by pressing a separate button. Enemies usually drop health-restoring or stat-enhancing items when defeated.

game.name: Kimchiman Gp32
game.desc: This is a side-scrolling 2D platformer action game. You are Kimchi-man, a person who has to try to save the earth from an evil cook

game.name: Little Wizard
game.desc: Entertaining and happy-looking 2D 1-on-1 fantasy fighting game with a setting reminiscent of young Harry Potter. The idea of students of a wizard school fighting each other is cool, and the fact that you learn additional abilities/spells as you make progress is also a good incentive to play the game through. The cartoony, colorful and nicely drawn graphics coupled with the smooth characters animations make this game a pleasure to play. Bottom line: Definitely one of the better fighting games on any portable console, the warm graphics and clever gameplay will make it last longer than you may expect.

game.name: Rally Pop
game.desc: Rally Pop is basically Worms except you use cell phones. It is basically an artillery game in which you take turns trying to bomb your opponents phone with different weapons. Also there is no story line. Game play : In the game you can be eight to ten different cell phones that all have their own unique ammo that they fire. The stages are drawn kind of goofy and of course there is wind to affect your bullets speed and etc. It is hard not because of the wind or etc but because after one or two shots the computer already knows your coordinates and will siege you to death before you even know his coordinates.

game.name: Raphael
game.desc: Underneath the mediocre graphics and barely existent story, there's a classic game just begging to be played. Quite literally in fact, as Raphael is a port of the ASCII published MSX game Castle Excellent from 1985.

game.name: Tomak - Save The Earth, Again
game.desc: Tomak: Save the Earth, Again is a horizontal scrolling shooter from Korea. The graphics are reminiscent of the artwork in the Metal Slug series, with large enemies and giant bosses at the end of the levels that take most of the screen state. As in most titles of this genre, the game is divided in stages with a unique boss enemy at the end. The player controls one of three bizarre characters: a girl inside a flowerpot called Evian, the red demon Bastylo or a wizard named Night Moon Shine. As they fly around shooting at the oncoming foes, each successful hit increases a charge point meter at the top of the screen, below the health bar. This accumulated blue energy is used by the secondary weapons, that can be selected at any time to switch to more effective and powerful shots. Up to two players can cooperate in Arcade Mode, or compete for points in the Versus Mode.

game.name: Treasure Island
game.desc: The main objective of the game is to drop bombs though the correct holes to bomb your opponent. Now this may sound easy however it is not. The tubes that you drop your bombs in will correspond to only one tube on your opponent's side. During boss fights every few turns the tubes will change order and there will be many more tubes (8 instead of the normal 6). In the game, you will also be able to get items to aid you in battle by either tossing a bomb through a tube that leads to a target or by just random npcs on the island that you meet. After you win a battle your icon on the island's map will move X amount of spaces. Depending on how many turns it took to defeat your opponent, you will get to move X amount of spaces on the island, with 3 as the maximum. The point of moving is to get to the end of the island to challenge the boss at the end it to get to the next portion of the island. The game consists of 4 maps.

game.name: W.b.w. - Wanna Be Wizard!
game.desc: Wanna be Wizard is a japanese-style Action-RPG based on a one-way story of a girl willing to become a wizard and of her island. Battle scene will be like a beat them up. Items, different levels of power, magic spells,... will be available and you'll be able to control both characters.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

game.name: Wizard Slayer
game.desc: Review - Wizard Slayer is a nice side scrolling shooter with excellent graphics all around reminiscent of Cotton. Levels are very colorful, the scrolling is smooth and the parallax layers are a definite plus. On the bad side, some levels seem to go by uneventfully, as they stretch for what seems to be a long time. Also, the enemies you will face are very detailed and well animated but they should have been more varied.

game.name: Blue Angelo - Angels From The Shrine
game.desc: Blue Angelo is an action / adventure title in which the hero is given evolutive capabilities. You live on the planet Lyria on which a mysterious glow encouraging the appearance of demons appears every thirty years. It's up to you to fight against this invasion. A second character is unlocked once you have completed the game a first time.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción
